planning.seed_reason: Official OMPL aliases seed0 to1. Labels0/1 map prospectively to distinct positive native seeds1/2, set before all RNG construction in a fresh process per job.
planning.finalization_policy: Common2s reserve is part of10s, not extra. Charge request serialization, process/bridge, native solve/replay, output read and independent Python certificate. A certificate finishing after10s is deadline_rejected, never M success.
planning.state_metric: Compound R3, SO2, pitch subspaces each weight1; no parameter tuning
planning.control_sampler: Official default uniform real-vector control; RRT SimpleDirectedControlSampler one candidate and uniform integer duration; SST official uniform control and duration; identical bounds/support
planning.algorithm_differences: Official SST rejects incomplete sampled durations; official control RRT can retain valid prefixes. Preserve and disclose these tree semantics, do not patch algorithms.
planning.objective: Control arc length v*T at frozen v=1, provided through the official optimization objective API; no new tree algorithm
planning.termination: First returned official exact solution or common8s cap; approximate/no_solution retained, no approximate upgraded to exact
planning.historical_reachability: F_O1/F_N1/F_B1 geometry_only_kinodynamic_unknown; six analytic tasks have independent supplied-control witnesses hidden from planner requests
planning.initial_state: Use exact registered6A initial state for analytic tasks; oldF uses frozen goal-facing yaw and zero pitch; native and LOS share same q0
planning.execution: serial CPU; one fresh native process per job; no seed screening or runtime parameter selection

reference_contract.native_vs_tracking: M/K native strict model-feasible within planning budget; S/E among actually run eligible LOS references; S/K complete task rate. Return/status/clock/audit gates all explicit. No algorithm superiority claim.
